# APX Data Specification: Data Dictionary

*Proposed additions to the APDS data model · Draft for the APDS committee · based on APDS 4.1 (2026-01-14) · APX 0.14.0*

## Introduction

This data dictionary gives the definitions and characteristics of the
classes, attributes, association roles and enumerations that APX proposes
for the APDS data model. It follows the APDS 4.1 Data Dictionary: the
first part is ordered by UML package, and each package lists its classes,
specializations, associations and attributes; the third part lists the
enumerations alphabetically. No new datatypes are proposed.

Only proposed content is listed. Where a class or enumeration already
exists in APDS 4.1, only the attributes, associations or values proposed
for addition appear, and the class is marked "extends APDS".

The tables use the columns of the APDS 4.1 Data Dictionary:

1. **Class name:** the symbolic name (UpperCamelCase) of the class.
2. **Change:** whether the class is new, or an existing APDS class that
   the proposal extends. This column is added for review and would not
   appear in an adopted data dictionary.
3. **Association end / Attribute name / Enumerated value name:** the
   symbolic name (lowerCamelCase).
4. **Designation:** the name in natural language.
5. **Definition:** the definition of the class, attribute, role or value.
6. **Stereotype:** the stereotype assigned to the class, per EN 16157-1
   Clause 6.1.
7. **Abstract:** whether the class is abstract.
8. **Multiplicity:** the allowed multiplicity, written m..n, where m is
   0 for optional and 1 or more for mandatory, and n is a number or `*`.
9. **Target:** the class at the end of the association.
10. **Type:** the datatype, class or enumeration of the attribute. Where
    an attribute is a reference, the referenced class follows in
    parentheses, as in APDS.

## A.2 Data dictionary of <<D2Datatype>> for "Parking"

No new datatypes are proposed. Every attribute uses an existing APDS 4.1 datatype, class or enumeration, or one proposed in this document.

## A.3 Data dictionary of <<D2Enumeration>> for "Parking"

### A.3.1 The <<D2Enumeration>> "AccessDenialReasonEnum"

Why an access attempt was refused.

*Table A.46 -- Values contained in the enumeration "AccessDenialReasonEnum"*

| Enumerated value name | Designation | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| credentialSuspended | Credential suspended | The presented credential matched an assigned credential that is suspended. |
| credentialLost | Credential lost | The presented credential matched an assigned credential reported lost. |
| credentialRevoked | Credential revoked | The presented credential matched an assigned credential that is revoked. |
| credentialReplaced | Credential replaced | The presented credential matched an assigned credential that has been replaced by another. |
| credentialExpired | Credential expired | The presented credential matched an assigned credential that has expired. |
| credentialNotYetActive | Credential not yet active | The presented credential matched an assigned credential that is issued but not yet active. |
| unknownCredential | Unknown credential | The presented value matched no assigned credential. |
| passback | Passback | Refused by the anti-passback rule because the credential is already inside or already outside. |
| accountBalance | Account balance | Refused because of the holder's outstanding balance or account standing. |
| outsidePlace | Outside place | The credential is valid, but not at this Place. |
| outsideValidity | Outside validity | The credential is valid at this Place, but not at this time. |

### A.3.2 The <<D2Enumeration>> "AccessDirectionEnum"

Whether a vehicle or person was entering or leaving.

*Table A.47 -- Values contained in the enumeration "AccessDirectionEnum"*

| Enumerated value name | Designation | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| entry | Entry | Entering the Place. |
| exit | Exit | Leaving the Place. |

### A.3.3 The <<D2Enumeration>> "AccessOutcomeEnum"

The result of an access attempt.

*Table A.48 -- Values contained in the enumeration "AccessOutcomeEnum"*

| Enumerated value name | Designation | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |

| stale | Stale | Closed by rule after no observation for the Place's maximum stay. |
| parentExit | Parent exit | An area Session closed because the wider visit it belongs to ended. |
| areaLeft | Area left | An area Session closed because the vehicle was seen leaving the area. |
| inventorySweep | Inventory sweep | A sweep of the Place found the vehicle gone. |
| valetHandback | Valet handback | The valet service handed the vehicle back. |
| exitOnly | Exit only | An exit with no observed entry; the start time is a placeholder. |
| operator | Operator | A person closed the Session. |
| review | Review | A reviewer paired the exit observation that closed the Session. |

### A.3.74 The <<D2Enumeration>> "ViolationTypeEnum"

The kinds of parking violation.

*Table A.119 -- Values contained in the enumeration "ViolationTypeEnum"*

| Enumerated value name | Designation | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| noValidRight | No valid right | No AssignedRight or paid Session covers the vehicle at the place at the observed time. |
| expiredRight | Expired right | The nearest AssignedRight or Session covering the vehicle has ended. |
| notYetValidRight | Not yet valid right | The vehicle's right exists but its validity has not started. |
| wrongPlace | Wrong place | The vehicle holds a right for a different element of the Place hierarchy, such as another zone, level, lot or space. |
| maximumStayExceeded | Maximum stay exceeded | The stay exceeds the place's maximum-stay restriction regardless of payment. |
| restrictedSpace | Restricted space | The vehicle occupies a space it is not eligible for, such as an accessible, EV charging, loading, reserved or permit-only space. |
| permitMisuse | Permit misuse | A permit or credential is used by a vehicle it was not issued to, or is suspended, copied or otherwise invalid. |
| noParkingPeriod | No parking period | The vehicle is parked while the place is closed to parking, such as for street cleaning or an event. |
| obstruction | Obstruction | The vehicle obstructs a lane, access, exit, hydrant or another space. |
| chargingBayIdle | Charging bay idle | A vehicle stayed connected in an EV charging bay after charging ended, beyond the posted idle limit. |
| other | Other | A violation not otherwise listed; the notice carries the specifics. |
